{{Quote|Have you ever been to the entertainment district on Coruscant? I bet you haven't. Well, I'm going to take you out for the biggest nerf steak ever.|[[Hallena Devis]], to [[Ince]]|<ref name="NP">''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]''</ref>}}
The '''Uscru Entertainment District''', more commonly known as the '''Uscru District''', was a subdivision on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and the location of the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]], the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]], the [[Snapping Septoid/Legends|Snapping Septoid]], the [[Revwien Comedy Academy Playhouse/Legends|Revwien Comedy Academy Playhouse]] and the [[Vos Gesal Hotel/Legends|Vos Gesal Hotel]]. [[The POTU]], for "the Periphery of the Uscru," was an [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underworld]] area on the edge of the district. The district, located near the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]], was alive at night, with [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]] that lit up the streets. It was considered the outer layer between the jewel city and the Coruscant underworld.

[[File:RMQ-Uscru-RotJAVA.png|thumb|left|200px|The Coruscanti entertainment district]]
For many years, the [[Mayor/Legends|mayor]] of the Uscru District was the corrupt [[Ongree/Legends|Ongree]] [[Acros-Krik]]. While the Uscru District was infamous for its seedy lower levels, the upper region of the district attracted a more refined clientele. The Galaxies Opera House, owned by [[Romeo Treblanc]], was a popular venue among the glitterati of Coruscant.

The district was a known hangout of [[Death stick/Legends|death stick]] [[Slythmonger/Legends|dealers]].

The intersection of [[Daring Way]] and [[Vos Gesal Street/Legends|Vos Gesal Street]] in Uscru was considered one of the highest crime-rate areas on Coruscant.
